description: We are a team of curious minds passionate about space exploration, science, and technology. Our goal is to turn learning into an engaging adventure by building an interactive astronaut training game that helps young learners explore the challenges of surviving and managing an outpost on the Moon or Mars.
summary:
AstroTales makes space science exciting through an interactive, comic-based Mars exploration experience for children aged 7–12. Inspired by our childhood curiosity, we imagined what if textbooks were as colourful and engaging as comic books, making learning an adventure. Children explore two Martian landing regions, Elysium Planitia and Arcadia Planitia, while learning about solar flares, radiation risks, habitat systems, water, energy and sustainable food production. What makes AstroTales unique is its blend of comic storytelling and interactive decision-making. Instead of conventional quizzes, children make choices and experience their possible consequences throughout the mission. We also envision creating new opportunities for comic creators by bringing their artwork and stories into interactive games and educational experiences. Through imagination and scientific exploration, we aim to inspire curiosity, critical thinking and problem-solving.
“Turning Pages into Adventures and Learning into Action.”
details: The AstroTales - Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive, comic-based educational game designed especially for children aged 7–12 years, who have a natural curiosity about space and exploration. Our aim is to make learning about Mars fun and engaging through comic-book-style storytelling, illustrations, animations, and interactive missions. Players take the role of an astronaut, communicate with Mission Control, choose between Martian landing locations such as Elysium Planitia and Arcadia Planitia, and explore challenges related to water, solar energy, safety, and survival on Mars. Unlike traditional quiz-based games, our project does not follow a fixed right-or-wrong answer system. Instead, every choice leads to different consequences, allowing children to experience the outcomes of their decisions and develop problem-solving, decision-making, and resource-management skills. The project was developed with the assistance of AI tools like Canva (for comic pages and presentation),Netlify (for app deployment),Gemini ,ChatGPT and Claude( for script preparation ,code generation and image generation ) and implemented using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in Visual Studio Code. Our main goal is to combine comic books with interactive learning to encourage children's curiosity, creativity, and interest in space science.
